newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Death of Ivorian student causes stir.
newsitem.headline: Death of Ivorian student causes stir.

text.p: An opposition newspaper on Tuesday blamed police for the death of a student in Ivory Coast after a clash between police and students at the university.
The newspaper La Voie said the student had "succumbed to police brutality" but government ministers denied any police involvement.
Security Minister Marcel Dibonan Kone told state television the police were in no way involved and an investigaation had been launched.

Higher Education Minister Saliou Toure said the student had jumped from a first floor window at the time of a Sunday night clash, had received hospital treatment, gone to bed and then died on Monday evening.

Police and members of the banned student group FESCI had clashed at a university residence hall in Abidjan's Abobo suburb. Three FESCI militants were jailed for two years on January 7 for inciting violence and public order offences.
FESCI called a three-day strike from Wednesday to demand payment of grant arrears, extra student accomodation and release of its three militants.
